name: contract-duplicate-matrix-rows
goal: Reject duplicate state and input matrix rows without blocking distinct boundaries or viewports

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: An API can add two identical cases under one newly declared state; both registry admission and case comparison currently accept them.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing compare case rejects an extra old-state row but never supplies duplicate new-state rows; the validator case likewise checks duplicate IDs but not duplicate behavior coordinates.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The existing validate and compare cases both accept the same new API matrix row twice and fail their strengthened assertions.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Validate distinct state, input, fixture and viewport coordinates, and reject duplicate new cases during comparison.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The same validate and compare cases pass at f43d0d427e, including distinct boundaries, viewport overlap and admitted cyclic input graphs.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
